application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
REAR GARDEN		

T1	Common Lime (Tilia x europaea)	Pollard to around1.5m below the previous pollard points, removing approximately 7m of new growth.
        Final height 7m and spread 7m.	

T2	Common Lime (Tilia x europaea)	Re-Pollard back to previous pollard points removing approximately 4-5m of new growth.
        Final height 8m and spread 7m.


G3	Mixed Species	7 x fruit trees - Apple, Cherry, Pear, Cherry, Apple, Plum, Pear: Reduce crowns to the most recent previous reduction points, removing 
        approx. 1-2m of new growth.
        Final height 3-3.5m and final overall spread 2-2.5m. 	

T4	Apple (Malus domestica)	Fell to ground level as tree is dead.

T5	Strawberry Tree (Arbutus unedo)	Reduce limb to south by 50%/2m. Final height = unchanged at 5m and final spread = 4m.	

	FRONT GARDEN		

G5	Swedish Whitebeam (Sorbus x intermedia)	Reduce crown to the most recent previous reduction points, removing approx. 1-1.5m of new growth.
       Final height 3.5m and final overall spread 2-2.5m.
